request: Add an `add_victorops` view in hc/front/views.py for adding a VictorOps webhook URL to a project, like the other integrations.

summary.result_text:
I couldn't run the tests because the command needed approval and wasn't approved, so the fix is untested.

I didn't add a view to `hc/front/views.py`. In this repo each integration keeps its own views, and the VictorOps one already exists in `hc/integrations/victorops/views.py`. It's wired up through `hc/integrations/victorops/urls.py` as `hc-add-victorops`, the same way as opsgenie and the others.

The existing view was broken, though. `urls.py` points to `views.add`, but the function was named `add_splunk_oncall`. Loading the URLconf would fail with an `AttributeError`. I renamed the function to `add` in `hc/integrations/victorops/views.py`. That matches the other integrations. Nothing else in the repo referenced the old name.

To check it, run `python manage.py test hc.integrations.victorops`.

If you do want the view in `hc/front/views.py` anyway, I can move it. That would break the one-module-per-integration pattern and mean updating `urls.py` and the import in the VictorOps module.

input.command: cat hc/integrations/victorops/urls.py && git status --short && git log --oneline | head -3 && grep -n "add_victorops\|^from\|^import" hc/front/views.py | head -60
ls hc/integrations | head -50; cat hc/integrations/opsgenie/urls.py; grep -n "^def \|^@" hc/integrations/opsgenie/views.py; grep -rn "views.add\b\|add_splunk_oncall" hc | head
